corpusHelp: Path to a checkout of the agc-template-market-harmonyos-demos corpus. Left null so no machine-specific path is committed — pass --corpus <dir> or set HARMONY_CORPUS.
comment: Validation set for the HarmonyOS producer. Chosen to span four axes: project size (2–44 modules), navigation system (Navigation vs legacy router), JSON5 dirtiness (the single-quote / unquoted-key files that silently lost module dependencies), and cloud usage.

projects.why: largest (44 modules, 1075 ets) + dirtiest JSON5 (18 files)
richest module.json5: deep links + form extension + querySchemes
mid-size, high route density (10 route maps for 14 modules)
single-quoted JSON5 values in oh-package dependencies
unquoted JSON5 keys — the worst offender (8 dirty files)
clean baseline: @Entry + Tabs, zero dirty JSON5
